Daily Tea Documentation

Welcome to the documentation for Daily Tea, a Django-based news application.

Daily Tea provides functionality for managing news articles, publishers, editors, journalists, newsletters, user accounts, subscriptions, and article approval workflows.

The project also provides a REST API for selected application functionality.
